mapper.select: select id, username, password, nickname, phone, role, create_time, update_time from volunteer_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, username, password, nickname, phone, role, create_time, update_time from volunteer_user where phone = #{phone} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into volunteer_user (username, password, nickname, phone, role, create_time, update_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{role}, now(), now())
